values: 被动地，自身获得可自动恢复的“树藤之护”护盾。主动释放时，持续挥舞大刀对面前的敌人造成伤害。

Passive. Tilaya gains Vine Ward, a shield that gradually recovers its value over time.
Active. Tilaya swings her greatsword repeatedly, dealing damage to enemies in front.

被动地，战斗开始时自身失去70%的生命值，获得至多可抵御120% + 12% HP伤害的“树藤之护”护盾，“树藤之护”每秒自动恢复10% + 1% HP的护盾值，其存在时自身处于霸体状态。“树藤之护”被击破时，进入3秒的冷却，冷却结束后“树藤之护”护盾量直接恢复至45% HP。
主动释放时，缇洛亚挥舞大刀8次，每次挥刀对前方2格扇形范围内敌人造成两次60% ATK伤害。期间获得70%减伤效果，且每受到4次伤害后使挥刀次数增加一次，至多挥刀12次。如果范围内没有敌人，会朝最近的敌人突进后继续挥刀。本技能的主动效果不受急速影响。

Passive. When a battle starts, Tilaya loses 70% HP and gains Vine Ward, a shield that blocks up to 120% + 12% HP damage. Vine Ward automatically recovers 10% + 1% HP shield value every second and makes Tilaya unaffected while active. When Vine Ward breaks, it enters a 3-second cooldown, after which its shield value is restored to 45% HP.
Active. Tilaya swings her greatsword 8 times, hitting enemies within a 2-tile arc in front. Each swing deals 60% ATK damage twice. While casting this skill, Tilaya reduces her damage taken by 70%; every time she takes 4 hits, she performs an additional swing, up to 12 swings total. If no enemies are within range, Tilaya charges toward the nearest enemy and continues casting this skill. Tilaya's Haste stat does not affect this skill when used actively.
主动释放时，每次挥刀造成的伤害提升至65% ATK。
Increases each swing hit's damage to 65% ATK when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，每次挥刀造成的伤害提升至70% ATK。
Increases each swing hit's damage to 70% ATK when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，每次挥刀造成的伤害提升至75% ATK。
Increases each swing hit's damage to 75% ATK when this skill is used actively.
主动释放时，每次挥刀造成的伤害提升至80% ATK。
Increases each swing hit's damage to 80% ATK when this skill is used actively.
对目标发起一次蓄力戳刺，并恢复“树藤之护”护盾。
Tilaya launches a powerful strike on her target and restores shield value to Vine Ward.
缇洛亚短暂蓄力后对当前目标发起一次强力攻击，造成220% ATK伤害，“树藤之护”存在时，还会回复实际伤害量160% + 15%的“树藤之护”护盾。
Tilaya charges briefly and launches a powerful strike on her target, dealing 220% ATK damage. If Vine Ward is active, she restores its shield value by 160% + 15% of the damage dealt.
Increases the damage dealt to 230% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 240% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 250% ATK.
使大刀与植物产生共鸣，接下来一段时间内自身对敌人造成伤害时会附加基于自身护盾量的伤害。
Tilaya's greatsword resonates with nearby plants, causing her attacks to deal extra damage based on her current shield value for a certain duration.
缇洛亚使大刀与植物产生共鸣，接下来10秒内对敌人造成伤害时，会额外附加自身当前护盾量6% + 1%的伤害，附加伤害至多不超过200% ATK。使用该技能时自身2格范围内每有1名友军，增益效果时间延长3.5秒。

Tilaya's greatsword resonates with nearby plants, causing her attacks to deal extra damage equal to 6% + 1% of her current shield value for 10s. This extra damage cannot exceed 200% ATK.
When Tilaya casts this skill, the duration of the resonance is extended by 3.5s for each ally within 2 tiles.
附加伤害提升至自身当前护盾量的7% + 1%。
Increases the extra damage to 7% + 1% of Tilaya's current shield value.
附加伤害提升至自身当前护盾量的8% + 1%。
Increases the extra damage to 8% + 1% of Tilaya's current shield value.
附加伤害提升至自身当前护盾量的9% + 1%。
Increases the extra damage to 9% + 1% of Tilaya's current shield value.
战斗中，自身的受愈提升11点。
战斗中，自身的受愈提升15点。
战斗中，自身的受愈提升19点。
“树藤之护”被击破后，恢复的护盾量获得提升。
After the first Vine Ward break, the shield value recovered after cooldown increases.
“树藤之护”首次被击破时，不再具有冷却时间，直接获得120% HP的护盾量。后续“树藤之护”被击破时，冷却期后的回复量提升至60% HP。

The first time Vine Ward breaks, it instantly recovers 120% HP shield value without triggering its cooldown. For subsequent Vine Ward breaks, the shield value recovered after cooldown is increased to 60% HP.
“树藤之护”冷却期后的回复量提升至70% HP。
Increases the shield value recovered after Vine Ward's cooldown to 70% HP.
“树藤之护”累计存在15秒后，增强与植物的共鸣，使处于自身2格范围内所有友军提升40%的最大生命值和60%护甲魔抗。友军通过本技能获得的最大生命值不超过缇洛亚自身初始最大生命值的80%。

After Vine Ward remains active for 15s, its bond with nature deepens. While active, it increases the max HP by 40% and Phys & Magic DEF by 60% for all allies within 2 tiles. The max HP gained from this effect cannot exceed 80% of Tilaya's initial max HP.
“树藤之护”冷却期后的回复量提升至80% HP。
Increases the shield value recovered after Vine Ward's cooldown to 80% HP.
终极技能期间提升“树藤之护”的恢复速度。
Increases Vine Ward's shield recovery speed while Tilaya casts her Ultimate.
终极技能期间，“树藤之护”恢复速度提升至每秒15% HP。
Increases Vine Ward's shield value recovery to 15% HP per second while Tilaya casts her Ultimate.
